# Academix
> Automated academic job sourcing, multilingual translation, and intelligent candidate CV matching pipeline.

## Overview
Academix is an open-source, self-hosted academic recruitment and candidate discovery platform written in Python. It aggregates over 20,000 active academic listings from 6 premier research portals (EURAXESS, AcademicTransfer, ABG, Nature Careers, ResearchGate, and EuroScienceJobs), normalizes multilingual text with local neural machine translation (NLLB-200), extracts structured research profiles using local LLMs (Ollama with Instructor), and executes high-precision matching using semantic degree gating and asymmetric vector similarity pooling.

## Key Features
- Full-scroll discovery & sourcing across 6 major academic job boards:
  - EURAXESS (EU Commission research portal)
  - AcademicTransfer (Dutch universities & research institutes)
  - ABG - Association Bernard Gregory (French doctorates, CIFRE, CNRS)
  - Nature Careers (Global scientific faculty & postdoc openings)
  - ResearchGate (Global scientific & academic jobs)
  - EuroScienceJobs (European science & policy positions)
- Local multilingual translation engine:
  - Paragraph & sentence boundary splitting with Sentencex
  - Fast language detection with Lingua
  - Dynamic FLORES-200 code resolution via Langcodes
  - CTranslate2 quantized int8 NLLB-200 inference (~600MB RAM)
  - Markdown structure & URL preservation
- Structured metadata refinement:
  - OpenAI-compatible local LLM inference via Ollama (Gemma 4, Llama 3)
  - Type-safe schema extraction using Instructor and Pydantic
  - Structured extraction of education level, required skills, degree fields, research areas, and deadlines
- Multi-vector embedding & matching algorithm:
  - Nomic Embeddings (`nomic-embed-text-v1.5`)
  - Hierarchical degree level filtering (PhD >= Master >= Bachelor)
  - Semantic degree field similarity threshold (0.71 cosine cutoff)
  - Asymmetric Max-Dominance pooling (0.70 * max(skill, research) + 0.30 * min(skill, research))
  - LLM-generated matching explanations for candidates
- Multi-channel interfaces:
  - RESTful FastAPI gateway
  - Telegram Bot interface for candidate onboarding, CV PDF upload, and instant position alerts

## Architecture & Monorepo Structure
- `packages/core`: Clean architecture domain models, database repositories, use cases, and LLM adapters.
- `packages/api`: FastAPI gateway server with Alembic database migrations.
- `packages/agents`: Autonomous worker services (discovery, sourcing, translation, refinement, embedding, matching, cv-parsing, telegram-bot, cleanup).
